messages.subject: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our pricing and standard terms for your requirements.

For this item, we can offer a price of €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some background on our current cost structure, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

We value our business relationship and look forward to serving you from our extensive product range.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels) (1)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Thank you for your counter-offer and the proposed 24-month contract with the AS-14404 index clause. In response to your preferred terms, we can offer a revised price of €5.70 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

To factor in your mentioned volume of 23,700 kg per year, we kindly ask you to share your historical consumption data or a binding release schedule. Which volume can you commit to? Please note that material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. 

This offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels) (2)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €5.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, we can offer a package with a price of €5.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

While we appreciate your volume commitment, we still require a binding release schedule to fully factor this into our pricing. Which volume can you commit to? A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. 

We cannot offer a fixed price over a 24-month term, so we must maintain the AS-14404 index clause. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. We can accept 60-day payment terms and have reduced our price to €5.60 per unit. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. 

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels) (3)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for accepting the AS-14404 index clause, which is essential for a 24-month agreement. As your proposed base price does not reflect a substantial move, we are unable to make further concessions at this stage. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our current offer stands at a price of €5.60 per unit, a Zahlungsziel of 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Please note that this offer stays valid for 7 days.

Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. Which volume can you commit to? A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. We truly value working with you and look forward to serving your needs.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
